info.name: Boiaro Category Sections API
info.description:
Homepage Category Sections REST API for Boiaro mobile app.
Base URL: {{base_url}}/api/v1/category-sections

Returns admin-configured homepage sections, each containing a category and its latest approved books.
All cover_url and category icon values are fully resolved absolute URLs.

request.description:
Returns all homepage category sections in display order.

Each section contains:
- Section title and subtitle (admin-configured)
- Category info with resolved icon URL
- Latest approved books (up to book_limit)

Use `category_id` to build "View All" links: /books?category={category_id}

No authentication required.

response.name: Success
